gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YE-AFTER EFFECTS - OKUTSHA
Uguqulelo 9.2.8  -  ngo-Oktobha 2026
================================================================================

Ipaneli ngoku ithetha ngeLWIMI EZILI-132, kukho IITHIMA EZINTSHA ze-DEMON SLAYER
ezinekrele elinqumla amaqhosha owacinezelayo, kunye nezilungiso ezimbalwa zoyilo ne-Windows.

PHAMBI KOKUBA UQALE
- Faka phezu kwenguqulelo yakho yangoku usebenzisa isifakeli sakho se-ZXP
  esiqhelekileyo, uze uqalise kwakhona i-After Effects kube kanye.
- Izicwangiso zakho, ithima, ii-preset nee-expression ogcinileyo ziyagcinwa.

KUTSHA: IPANELI KWIILWIMI EZILI-132
- Izicwangiso ze-Flex > ULWIMI ngoku luchaza iilwimi ezili-132, kunye nebhokisi
  yokukhangela. Khetha ulwimi kwaye lonke ipaneli liyatshintsha: iithebhu, amaqhosha, amacebiso, imiyalezo.
- Ulwimi ngalunye lutolikwe yi-AI ukusuka kwipaneli yesiNgesi, hayi igama negama.
  Amagama owabonayo kwiprojekthi yakho (amagama eelayer, amagama eziphumo)
  asala esiNgesini ukuze aqhubeke ehambelana ne-After Effects.
- Ifestile ethi "okutsha" nayo iyatolikwa, ukususela kule nguqulelo.

KUTSHA: IITHIMA ZE-DEMON SLAYER
- Izicwangiso ze-Flex > UMKHETHI WETHIMA ineqela elitsha le-DEMON SLAYER elineethima ezili-11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen kunye no-Kokushibo.
- Hambisa imawusi phezu kwepaneli kwaye into yethima iyayilandela: amanzi,
  amalangatye, umbane, amabhabhathane, amaxolo eentyatyambo, inkungu nokunye.
  Xa imawusi imisa, iyanyamalala kancinci.
- Cofa iqhosha kwaye ikrele lalo mlinganiswa liyalinqumla. Bamba iqhosha lasekhohlo
  licinezelekile liqhubeke linqumla; ulibambe malunga neesekhondi ezi-2.5 liqhume.
- Yenzelwe ukuba ibe lula: iziphumo ziqhuba kuphela xa uhambisa okanye ucofa,
  kwaye ziba lula ngokwazo kwiikhompyuter ezicothayo. Cima IZIPHUMO ZENDAWO
  kuMkhethi wethima ukuze ugcine imibala kuphela.

KUTSHINTSHILE: AMAQHOSHA AFLETHI KUYO YONKE ITHIMA
- Amaqhosha asebenzayo nawona aphambili kwiithima zemibala akasayisebenzisi
  i-gradient enesithunzi esisuka phezulu siye ezantsi. Ngoku ngumbala omnye ofleti
  onokukhanya okuthambileyo, ngoko abukeka ecocekile kwaye afundeke ngcono.

KULUNGISIWE
- Ikhadi lelayisensi nefestile ethi "okutsha" zazinokuvuleka enye phezu kwenye.
  Ngoku azigqithani, kwaye ibheji ethi HLAZIYA ayisawagquli amaqhosha aphezulu
  epanelini.
- Kwi-UI SCALE 125% ne-150%, ezinye iifestile (njengefestile ethi Izicwangiso
  ze-Flex) zazinokuba zide kunepaneli, ngoko iqhosha lazo lokuvala lalingabonakali.
  Ngoku zonke iifestile ziyangena kuzo zonke iisayizi.
- Windows: i-AutoCaptions yayinokuthi "I-DRAYIVA YE-NVIDIA IMDALA KAKHULU KWI-GPU
  CAPTIONS" kwiikhadi nakwiidrayiva ezintsha (uthotho lwe-RTX 40 ne-50). Ngoku
  ifunda inkxaso ye-CUDA yedrayiva ngokuchanekileyo kwaye isebenzisa i-GPU yakho.

AKUTSHINTSHANGA
- Ilayisensi, ukwenza kusebenze kunye nawo onke amakhonkco asebenza kanye njengangaphambili.
- Zonke ezinye iithebhu nezixhobo zisebenza kanye njengakwi-9.2.7.
================================================================================

FLEX ULTIMATE YE-PREMIERE PRO - OKUTSHA
Uguqulelo 2.2.8  -  ngo-Oktobha 2026

Ii-caption ze-ISITAKI SOMBHALO ngoku zii-template ze-Motion Graphics EZIHLELEKAYO
ezinomhleli wokwenyani, kukho i-AUDIO STUDIO entsha kunye ne-MARKA IBEATS ZEAUDIO,
ipaneli ithetha ngeLWIMI EZILI-132, i-UI SCALE iyafika kwi-ULTIMATE, kukho neethima ze-DEMON SLAYER.

PHAMBI KOKUBA UQALE
- Faka phezu kwenguqulelo yakho yangoku usebenzisa isifakeli sakho se-ZXP
  esiqhelekileyo, uze uqalise kwakhona i-Premiere Pro kube kanye.
- Izicwangiso zakho, ithima nee-preset ziyagcinwa.

KUTSHA: ISITAKI SOMBHALO - II-CAPTION EZIHLELEKAYO (FX & ADV RIGS > ISITAKI SOMBHALO)
- Ii-caption ngoku zibekwa njengee-template ze-Motion Graphics ezihlelekayo
  (Okuphumayo > MOGRT EHLELEKAYO, okuyisiqhelo esitsha kwi-Premiere Pro 2026).
  Emva kokubeka, tshintsha nawuphi na igama, ifonti, umbala, ubungakanani, indawo,
  ukukhanya, umda, ibhokisi, i-animation okanye ixesha kwipaneli ye-Essential Graphics ye-Premiere.
- Okuphumayo > IMIFANEKISO kusabeka igama ngalinye njengomfanekiso onje ngoko kanye,
  ukuba uyakukhetha oko.
- Ii-template ziza nepaneli. Akukho nto yokukhuphela.

KUTSHA: UMHLELI WE-ISITAKI SOMBHALO
- Ukubukwa kwangaphambili ngoku kubonisa ifreyimu yokwenyani yevidiyo yakho phantsi kwe-caption nganye.
- Tsala i-caption ukuyihambisa, sebenzisa ikona ukutshintsha ubungakanani kunye
  nenqaku elingaphezulu ukuyijikelezisa, cofa kabini igama ukuyihlela. I-CAPTION
  ISONKE ihambisa onke amagama kunye, IGAMA LINYE lihambisa igama elinye.
- Khetha ukuba utshintsho lusebenza kuzo zonke ii-caption okanye kule caption kuphela,
  kwaye ugcine uyilo lwakho ukuze usisebenzise kwakhona.
- Iimbonakalo ezintsha ezili-10 ze-GLOW: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow kunye neSuperb.

KUTSHA: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Khetha iklip yesandi, khetha isiphumo uze ucinezele SEBENZISA. Yonke into iqhuba
  kwikhompyuter yakho.
- Ii-preset ezili-30 zecofa elinye: Underwater, Bass Boost, i-reverb ye-Room / Hall /
  Cathedral / Plate, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse nokunye. Beka
  iziphumo ezininzi njengoko ufuna, uziququzelele kwakhona okanye ucime enye.
- I-Reverb igcina umsila wayo: isandi siyaqhubeka ngaphaya kokuphela kweklip, kwaye
  sibekwa ukuze kungabikho nto kwi-timeline yakho ibhalwa phezulu.
- Izixhobo: Ukususa Ingxolo, Ukuphucula Ilizwi, Ukuvakala (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Ukususa i-Hum, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Isantya
  kunye ne-Pitch, Noise Gate, Ukukhupha i-Audio.
- I-STEMS MAKER ihlula ingoma ibe ngamazwi nomculo (okanye ii-stem ezi-4). Ikhuphela
  imodeli yayo okokuqala kwaye ikubuza kuqala.
- UKUBUKWA KWANGAPHAMBILI kukuvumela uve malunga neesekhondi ezi-8 ngeswitshi
  ye-Original / Processed. Isiphumo sibekwa kwitrack yesandi esikhululekileyo
  kwaye iklip yakho yoqobo iyathuliswa, ayisoze isuswe.

KUTSHA: MARKA IBEATS ZEAUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > MARKA IBEATS ZEAUDIO)
- Khetha iklip yomculo kwi-timeline uze ucinezele MARKA IBEATS: i-Flex ifumana
  ii-beat kwaye yongeza iimarker zesequence kuzo, ukuze ukusika kwakho kuhambelane
  ngqo nomculo.
- Khetha ZONKE ii-hit, ii-KICKS okanye ii-SNARES, setha ukuvakalelwa, kwaye
  uphawule yonke i-beat okanye yonke ye-2 okanye ye-4.
- SUSA IIMARKER ZE-BEAT isusa kuphela iimarker ezongezwe yi-Flex. Iqhuba
  kwikhompyuter yakho.

KUTSHA: IPANELI KWIILWIMI EZILI-132
